case_title: Kantilal Martaji Pandor v. State of Gujarat & Anr.
high_court_outcome: Acquitted from Section 306, maintained conviction under Section 498A
neutral_facts: The accused, a teacher, was married to Laxmiben. He later married Amriben, a teacher, and they had a daughter. Amriben wrote a letter to the police station alleging that the accused was living off her salary, was torturing her, and threatened to kill her. The next day, Amriben jumped into a well and died. An FIR was registered under Sections 498A and 306 of the IPC. The trial court acquitted Laxmiben but convicted the accused under Sections 498A and 306. The High Court acquitted the accused from Section 306 but maintained the conviction under Section 498A. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's conviction under Section 498A, finding that the evidence did not sufficiently prove the accused committed cruelty as defined under the section.
